name: Electricity Price
description: Hourly electricity spot price (Ostrom API, gross incl. tax) for today, plus an outlook for the next days: tomorrow's published prices and a wind/solar-weather forecast beyond, with the cheapest day marked.

settings.name: client_id
settings.label: Ostrom Client ID
settings.help: From the Ostrom Developer Portal. Stored encrypted on disk.

settings.name: client_secret
settings.label: Ostrom Client Secret
settings.help: From the Ostrom Developer Portal. Stored encrypted on disk.

settings.name: zip
settings.label: ZIP code
settings.help: German postal code, used for location-specific grid fees in the gross price.

cell_options.name: outlook
cell_options.label: Show next days
cell_options.help: Extend the chart over the next days: tomorrow's real prices once published (~13:00), then a forecast from wind and solar weather (dashed). Hidden on the smallest cell size.

cell_options.name: typical_band
cell_options.label: Show typical range
cell_options.help: Hatched band behind today's line: the usual price range for each hour over the past 7 days (25th–75th percentile).
